text:
ralph: Heads up — after the 1750001000 runtime rollout I'm seeing a sharp p99 latency spike on us-east-1 serving pool. Investigating, but KV prefix cache hit-rate for model gpt-small-v3 collapsed from ~92% to ~12% around 20:12 UTC. Requests started hitting origin more. Anyone else seeing this?

maria: yup saw errors in APM too, traces show cache miss flood. p50 ok, p95->p99 gap huge.

sre-bot: alert: KEV_CACHE_HITRATE_DROP us-east-1 pool=gpt-small-v3 hitrate=12% threshold=30%

jules: pulled profiling artifacts from the node that hit highest miss rate. Key metrics: 
```
cache_lookups: 1_220_431
cache_misses: 1_056_103
evictions: 979_810
avg_kv_payload_bytes: 2.8k
kernel_selected: matmul_v2
batching_policy: dynamic_seq_window
```
Looks like evictions exploded after the deploy. kernel selection switched to matmul_v2 and batching heuristic changed to aggregate variable-length prefixes into larger requests — likely increasing working set per request.

tina: that matches an earlier perf test where matmul_v2 reduced compute but increased transient memory for KV slices. If we pack more prefixes per batch, we could exceed per-shard cache capacity and trigger mass evictions.

sam: can we confirm eviction timeline vs deploy?

ralph: timeline: deploy finished 1750001000, first hit-rate drop at 1750001120, steady low until interventions. Node logs show many LRU evict ops. Example from node-12: 
```
[20:13:07] kv_cache: evict key_prefix="user:session:..." size=4096 reason=capacity
[20:13:07] kv_cache: evict key_prefix="prompt:..." size=8192 reason=capacity
[20:13:08] kv_cache: miss key_prefix=... id=0x7f1a
```

maria: I can push a telemetry check to report per-shard used_bytes and max_bytes, but we need a quick mitigation. Options: rollback batching change, pin kernel to matmul_v1, or bump cache quota per shard.

jules: temp mitigation idea: reduce runtime config max_agg_prefixes from 8->2 to throttle batch footprint. Also set kernel selection override for affected model to matmul_v1.

sam: agree. Rolling back batching rollout now + pin kernel for gpt-small-v3. Deploying change to config service. Will also disable dynamic_seq_window flag for us-east-1.

deploy-bot: rollout-started: config-change id=cfg-7923 user=sam target=us-east-1 affected=gpt-small-v3

ralph: also noticed a noisy neighbor pattern — one customer was sending many short prefixes with huge variety, may be poisoning LRU working set. Could throttle per-customer prefix cardinality.

tina: good call. Add per-tenant prefix_count_limit=10 as an emergency policy for the pool.

sam: applied changes: max_agg_prefixes=2, kernel_override=matmul_v1, per_tenant_prefix_limit=10. Changes applied at 1750002420. Monitoring...

sre-bot: config-apply: success cfg-7923 target=us-east-1 ts=1750002420

jules: re-ran profiling 20m after mitigation: 
```
cache_lookups: 1_401_002
cache_misses: 143_220
evictions: 12_040
avg_kv_payload_bytes: 1.1k
hitrate: ~88%
```
Looks much better. p99 latency falling back toward baseline.

maria: nice. We should do a postmortem for the interaction: batching heuristic + kernel memory behavior + lack of per-tenant cardinality guard.

ralph: Agreed — short follow-ups: (1) revert batching change from rollout branch and re-evaluate in canary with stricter working-set checks, (2) add per-shard telemetry for used_bytes and eviction rate to alert earlier, (3) add per-tenant prefix cardinality limit as permanent guard, (4) add kernel memory footprint metric to model performance profiles.

sam: i'll open tickets and track. For immediate ops, we'll keep kernel_override for gpt-small-v3 until next validated rollout.

deploy-bot: rollout-completed: revert/override cfg-7923 status=success ts=1750003334

sre-bot: post-action metrics snapshot: p99 latency delta -480ms vs peak, hitrate recovered to 89% across pool by 1750003600

ralph: thanks all. We'll schedule a short retro tomorrow 14:00 UTC to capture lessons and decide permanent config changes. :thumbsup:

maria: adding logs and profiling artifacts to the incident folder.

jules: filing a perf regression note referencing kernel matmul_v2 and batching agg change.

sam: any objections to making per-tenant prefix limit default for all production pools?

tina: no objections. +1

ralph: closing thread when retro scheduled and tickets filed.

sre-bot: incident-closure-pending: tasks_open=3 owners=[sam,jules,ralph]
